author: Laura Beckett <laura.beckett@meridian.example>
title: Project formally kicked off (1 September)
evidence: Thanks for running the kickoff yesterday. On our side we consider the project formally started as of 1 September.

author: Laura Beckett <laura.beckett@meridian.example>
title: Phase 1 scope baseline agreed (inventory, POS, customer profile)
evidence: We agreed the scope baseline for phase 1: store inventory, point-of-sale integration and the customer profile service. Anything beyond that goes through change control.

author: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@northwind.example>
title: Legacy data quality threatens a clean migration and the go-live date
evidence: Flagging a risk before it becomes a blocker. The legacy product catalogue has around 12% of records with missing category codes, and the loyalty export has duplicate customer IDs.

author: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@northwind.example>
title: Confirm owner and deadline for the legacy data cleanup
evidence: Can you confirm who on the Meridian data team owns the cleanup, and by when? I need this to hold the schedule.

author: Tomasz Wojcik <tomasz.wojcik@northwind.example>
title: Phase 1 acceptance criteria fixed as binding for sign-off
evidence: Agreed. We will treat the three acceptance criteria you listed as binding for phase 1 sign-off: end-to-end sale under 3 seconds, zero data loss on the nightly sync, and a working returns flow.

author: Tomasz Wojcik <tomasz.wojcik@northwind.example>
title: Prepare UAT test cases against the agreed acceptance criteria
evidence: I will prepare the UAT test cases against these and share them by 25 September.

author: Laura Beckett <laura.beckett@meridian.example>
title: Client requests moving the loyalty module into phase 1
evidence: Our board wants the loyalty module included in phase 1 rather than phase 2. I know this is a scope change against the baseline we agreed at kickoff.

author: Laura Beckett <laura.beckett@meridian.example>
title: Assess timeline and cost impact of the loyalty change and recommend
evidence: Can Northwind assess the impact on the timeline and cost, and come back with a recommendation? We would like a view before the next steering committee.

author: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@northwind.example>
title: Proposed 12 October go-live, dry-run the week before
evidence: Proposing 12 October as the phase 1 go-live, with the migration dry-run the week before. That gives us a buffer if the dry-run surfaces issues.

author: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@northwind.example>
title: Cutover over 10-11 October with a code freeze from 8 October
evidence: Following the go-live target, here is the cutover plan for the weekend of 10-11 October. We freeze all non-critical changes from 8 October so the environment is stable going into cutover.

author: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@northwind.example>
title: Data drift risk if the store network is not read-only during cutover
evidence: Decision needed from your side: can Meridian confirm the store network will be in read-only mode during the cutover window? Without that we risk data drift between the old and new systems.

author: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@northwind.example>
title: On track for 12 October: POS integration tested, profile service at 80%
evidence: Delivery is broadly on track for the 12 October go-live. Point-of-sale integration passed internal testing this week. The customer profile service is at 80% of planned scope.

author: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@northwind.example>
title: Team at full capacity; loyalty change needs an extra developer or the date slips
evidence: One watch item: the team is running at full capacity, and the pending loyalty change request would need an extra developer to avoid slipping the date. I will bring options to the steering committee.
